mapper.select: SELECT t.tdm50_chck_job_id AS chck_job_id , t.tdm50_company_id AS company_id , t.tdm50_check_ym AS check_ym , t.tdm50_check_nm AS check_name , TO_CHAR(t.tdm50_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date , TO_CHAR(t.tdm50_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date , t.tdm50_end_yn AS end_yn , t.tdm50_appr_id AS appr_id , t.tdm50_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_code , t.tdm50_appr_status_nm AS appr_status_name , t.tdm50_lock_yn AS lock_yn , t.tdm50_batch_check_use_yn AS batch_check_use_yn FROM ( SELECT a.tdm50_chck_job_id , a.tdm50_company_id , a.tdm50_check_ym , a.tdm50_check_nm , a.tdm50_start_date , a.tdm50_end_date , a.tdm50_end_yn , b.apr01_appr_id AS tdm50_appr_id , b.apr01_status_cd AS tdm50_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS tdm50_appr_status_nm , ( SELECT CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(c.tdm53_lock_yn = 'true') THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM tdm53_chck_exct c WHERE c.tdm53_check_ym = a.tdm50_check_ym AND c.tdm53_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id ) AS tdm50_lock_yn , COALESCE(tdm91_batch_check_use_yn, 'false') AS tdm50_batch_check_use_yn FROM tdm50_chck_job a LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm91_company_setup ON ( tdm91_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id AND tdm91_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(tdm91_start_date) FROM tdm91_company_setup WHERE tdm91_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id AND tdm91_start_date <= a.tdm50_start_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tdm56_chck_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm56_appr_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '10' THEN 1 WHEN apr01_status_cd = '20' THEN 2 WHEN apr01_status_cd = '30' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END , apr01_appr_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) b ON b.tdm56_relate_table_id = a.tdm50_chck_job_id WHERE a.tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm} UNION ALL SELECT f_create_seq() AS tdm50_chck_job_id , CAST(#{companyId} AS numeric) AS tdm50_company_id , CAST(#{checkYm} AS varchar) AS tdm50_check_ym , CAST(#{checkYm} AS varchar) || ' 책무 이행점검' AS tdm50_check_nm , NULL::date AS tdm50_start_date , NULL::date AS tdm50_end_date , 'false' AS tdm50_end_yn , NULL::numeric AS tdm50_appr_id , NULL::varchar AS tdm50_appr_status_cd , NULL::varchar AS tdm50_appr_status_nm , 'false' AS tdm50_lock_yn , 'false' AS tdm50_batch_check_use_yn WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm} ) ) t

SELECT a.tdm50_chck_job_id AS chck_job_id , a.tdm50_company_id AS company_id , a.tdm50_check_ym AS check_ym , a.tdm50_check_nm AS check_name , TO_CHAR(a.tdm50_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date , TO_CHAR(a.tdm50_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date , a.tdm50_end_yn AS end_yn , b.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , b.apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name , ( SELECT CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(c.tdm53_lock_yn = 'true') THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM tdm53_chck_exct c WHERE c.tdm53_check_ym = a.tdm50_check_ym AND c.tdm53_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id ) AS lock_yn , 'false' AS batch_check_use_yn FROM tdm50_chck_job a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tdm56_chck_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm56_appr_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '10' THEN 1 WHEN apr01_status_cd = '20' THEN 2 WHEN apr01_status_cd = '30' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END , apr01_appr_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) b ON b.tdm56_relate_table_id = a.tdm50_chck_job_id WHERE a.tdm50_chck_job_id = #{chckJobId}

SELECT tdm20_role_id AS role_id , CONCAT(tdm20_role_nm, ' : '||cnt) AS role_name FROM tdm20_role LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tdm20_ceo_role_id ceo_id , COUNT(*) cnt FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm53_role_id WHERE tdm53_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm53_check_ym = #{checkYm} GROUP BY tdm20_ceo_role_id ) t ON ceo_id = tdm20_role_id WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm20_role_type = 'C' AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) ORDER BY tdm20_start_date, tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm50_chck_job ( tdm50_chck_job_id, tdm50_company_id, tdm50_check_ym, tdm50_check_nm, tdm50_start_date, tdm50_end_date, tdm50_end_yn, tdm50_upd_nm, tdm50_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{chckJobId}, #{companyId}, #{checkYm}, #{checkName}, CAST(#{startDate} AS date), CAST(#{endDate} AS date), 'false', #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN exct_appr_cnt != 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS exct_appr_yn , CASE WHEN check_end_cnt != 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS check_end_yn , CASE WHEN check_ing_cnt != 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS check_ing_yn , CASE WHEN manl_cnt = manl_appr_cnt THEN true ELSE false END AS manl_appr_yn FROM tdm50_chck_job LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) exct_appr_cnt /*(승인이 완료된 임원건수)*/ FROM tdm53_chck_exct WHERE tdm53_company_id = tdm50_company_id AND tdm53_check_ym = tdm50_check_ym AND COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') = 'true' ) t1 ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('10','11') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) check_end_cnt /*(점검완료 및 승인이 진행된 점검항목 건수)*/ , COUNT(*) check_ing_cnt /*(생성된 점검항목 건수)*/ FROM tdm51_chck_org LEFT JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id WHERE tdm51_company_id = tdm50_company_id AND tdm51_check_ym = tdm50_check_ym ) t2 ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) manl_appr_cnt /*(결재완료 책무매뉴얼 건수)*/ , COUNT(*) manl_cnt /*(전체 책무매뉴얼 건수)*/ FROM tdm42_manl_org LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm42_appr_id WHERE tdm42_company_id = tdm50_company_id AND (tdm50_check_ym||'.01')::date BETWEEN tdm42_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm42_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) ) t3 ON TRUE WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm}

SELECT tdm42_manl_org_id AS manl_org_id , tdm42_role_id AS role_id , tdm42_exct_id AS exct_id , tdm42_org_id AS org_id FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON ( apr01_appr_id = tdm42_appr_id AND apr01_status_cd = '30' ) WHERE tdm42_company_id = #{companyId} AND CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm42_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm42_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm51_chck_org ( tdm51_chck_org_id, tdm51_company_id, tdm51_check_ym, tdm51_role_id, tdm51_exct_id, tdm51_org_id, tdm51_chck_job_id, tdm51_manl_org_id, tdm51_upd_nm, tdm51_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{chckOrgId}, #{companyId}, #{checkYm}, #{roleId}, #{exctId}, #{orgId}, #{chckJobId}, #{manlOrgId}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )

INSERT INTO tdm52_chck_manl ( tdm52_chck_manl_id , tdm52_chck_org_id , tdm52_manl_id , tdm52_company_id , tdm52_checker_id , tdm52_upd_nm , tdm52_upd_date ) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{chckOrgId} , tdm43_manl_id , tdm43_company_id , tdm52_checker_id , #{updName} , f_sysdate() FROM tdm43_manl tdm43 LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm52_checker_id FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm43_manl a ON a.tdm43_manl_id = tdm52_manl_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * , f_get_tdmOrg_id(emp00_person_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) emp00_tmpOrg_id FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) ) emp00 ON emp00_person_id = tdm52_checker_id WHERE COALESCE(emp00_retire_date,'9999-12-31'::date) >= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) /*점검시작일 기준 퇴사자 체크*/ AND emp00_tmpOrg_id = tdm43.tdm43_org_id /*점검시작일 기준 점검자 부서이동 체크*/ AND a.tdm43_manl_cd = tdm43.tdm43_manl_cd AND tdm51_company_id = tdm43.tdm43_company_id AND tdm51_role_id = tdm43.tdm43_role_id AND tdm51_check_ym = CAST(#{preCheckYm} AS varchar) ) preMonth ON TRUE , ( SELECT f_get_last_day((f_get_quarter_date(start_date, '1') + interval '3month')::date) + 1 AS q_std_date , f_get_last_day((f_get_quarter_date(start_date, '2') + interval '6month')::date) + 1 AS h_std_date , (date_trunc('year' , start_date) + interval '12month')::date AS y_std_date , (date_trunc('month', start_date) + interval '1month')::date AS m_std_date FROM ( SELECT coalesce(sys01_tdm_start_date,'2026-07-01'::date) start_date FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId} ) sys01a ) sys01 WHERE tdm43_manl_org_id = #{manlOrgId} AND COALESCE(tdm43_start_date,'1900-01-01'::date) <= (CAST(#{checkYm} AS varchar)||'.01')::date AND CASE tdm43_check_cycle_cd WHEN '04' THEN q_std_date WHEN '05' THEN h_std_date WHEN '06' THEN y_std_date ELSE m_std_date END <= (CAST(#{checkYm} AS varchar)||'.01')::date AND CAST(#{month} AS varchar) IN ( /* 이번달에 해당하는 점검항목만 select */ SELECT LPAD(UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(pos::text, ', ')), 2, '0') FROM ( SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(tdm43_check_month)) pos ) t WHERE SUBSTR(tdm43_check_month, pos, 1) = '1' )

INSERT INTO tdm58_chck_appr_step ( tdm58_chck_appr_step_id , tdm58_chck_org_id , tdm58_appr_seq , tdm58_appr_emp_id , tdm58_upd_nm , tdm58_upd_date ) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{chckOrgId} , tdm09_appr_seq , tdm09_appr_emp_id , #{updName} , f_sysdate() FROM tdm09_appr_step WHERE tdm09_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm09_role_id = #{roleId} AND tdm09_org_id = #{orgId} AND tdm09_type_cd = 'T'

INSERT INTO tdm53_chck_exct ( tdm53_chck_exct_id , tdm53_company_id , tdm53_check_ym , tdm53_role_id , tdm53_exct_id , tdm53_exct_appr_yn , tdm53_lock_yn , tdm53_chck_job_id , tdm53_upd_nm , tdm53_upd_date ) SELECT f_create_seq() , tdm51_company_id , tdm51_check_ym , tdm51_role_id , tdm51_exct_id , 'false' , 'false' , #{chckJobId} , #{updName} , f_sysdate() FROM tdm51_chck_org WHERE tdm51_chck_job_id = #{chckJobId} GROUP BY tdm51_company_id, tdm51_check_ym, tdm51_role_id, tdm51_exct_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm53_chck_exct WHERE tdm53_chck_job_id = #{chckJobId} AND tdm53_exct_appr_yn = 'true' AND COALESCE(tdm53_lock_yn,'false') = 'false'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON ( tdm51_chck_job_id = tdm53_chck_job_id AND tdm51_role_id = tdm53_role_id ) INNER JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id WHERE tdm53_chck_job_id = #{chckJobId} AND COALESCE(tdm53_lock_yn,'false') = 'false'

SELECT t.tdm51_chck_org_id AS chck_org_id , t.tdm51_org_manager_id AS org_manager_id FROM ( SELECT tdm51_chck_org.* , tdm08_person_id AS tdm51_org_manager_id FROM tdm51_chck_org LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tdm08_org_id , tdm08_person_id FROM tdm08_manager_info WHERE tdm08_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm08_manager_type = '21' AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm08_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm08_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) tdm08 ON tdm08_org_id = tdm51_org_id ) t WHERE tdm51_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm51_check_ym = #{checkYm} AND tdm51_role_id IN ( SELECT tdm53_role_id FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm53_role_id WHERE tdm53_chck_job_id = #{chckJobId} AND tdm20_ceo_role_id IN ( SELECT tdm20_role_id FROM tdm20_role LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tdm20_ceo_role_id ceo_id , COUNT(*) cnt FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm53_role_id WHERE tdm53_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm53_check_ym = #{checkYm} GROUP BY tdm20_ceo_role_id ) t ON ceo_id = tdm20_role_id WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm20_role_type = 'C' AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) ) )

SELECT tdm53_chck_exct_id AS chck_exct_id , tdm53_chck_job_id AS chck_job_id , tdm53_role_id AS role_id , tdm53_exct_id AS exct_id , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm53_exct_id) AS exct_name , chck_manl_cnt AS chck_manl_cnt , tdm53_exct_appr_yn AS exct_appr_yn , tdm53_lock_yn AS lock_yn , CASE WHEN chck_manl_cnt = 0 THEN null ELSE 1 END AS button_enable FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm53_role_id INNER JOIN getPerson(tdm53_company_id, f_today()) ON emp00_person_id = tdm53_exct_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) chck_manl_cnt FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id WHERE tdm51_company_id = tdm53_company_id AND tdm51_check_ym = tdm53_check_ym AND tdm51_role_id = tdm53_role_id ) tdm52 ON TRUE WHERE tdm53_chck_job_id = #{chckJobId} AND tdm20_ceo_role_id = #{ceoRoleId} ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT t.tdm51_chck_org_id AS chck_org_id , t.tdm51_org_id AS org_id , t.tdm51_org_nm AS org_name , t.tdm51_org_manager_id AS org_manager_id , t.tdm51_org_manager_nm AS org_manager_name , t.tdm51_duty_cnt AS duty_cnt , t.tdm51_manl_cnt AS manl_cnt , t.tdm51_month_manl_cnt AS month_manl_cnt , t.tdm51_month_manl_done_cnt AS month_manl_done_cnt , t.tdm51_month_manl_undone_cnt AS month_manl_undone_cnt , t.tdm51_org_status_cd AS org_status_code , f_cdnm('TdmCheckStatus', t.tdm51_org_status_cd, t.tdm51_company_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AS org_status_name FROM ( SELECT tdm51_chck_org.* , org00_kor_nm AS tdm51_org_nm /*점검부서*/ , tdm08_person_id AS tdm51_org_manager_id /*부서담당자ID*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm08_person_id) AS tdm51_org_manager_nm /*부서담당자명*/ , duty_cnt AS tdm51_duty_cnt /*관리의무*/ , manl_cnt AS tdm51_manl_cnt /*점검항목*/ , CASE WHEN month_manl_cnt = 0 THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN month_manl_cnt = month_manl_25_cnt THEN '25' WHEN month_manl_cnt = month_manl_19_cnt THEN '19' WHEN month_manl_21_cnt != 0 THEN '21' WHEN month_manl_20_cnt != 0 THEN '20' WHEN month_manl_19_cnt != 0 THEN '11' WHEN month_manl_11_cnt != 0 THEN '11' ELSE '10' END) END AS tdm51_org_status_cd /*진행상태코드*/ , month_manl_cnt AS tdm51_month_manl_cnt /*당월 점검항목_대상*/ , ( month_manl_19_cnt + month_manl_20_cnt + month_manl_21_cnt + month_manl_25_cnt ) AS tdm51_month_manl_done_cnt /*당월 점검항목_완료*/ , month_manl_cnt - ( month_manl_19_cnt + month_manl_20_cnt + month_manl_21_cnt + month_manl_25_cnt ) AS tdm51_month_manl_undone_cnt /*당월 점검항목_미완료*/ FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON ( tdm50_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm50_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym ) INNER JOIN getOrg(tdm50_company_id, tdm50_start_date) org ON org00_org_id = tdm51_org_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm08_org_id, tdm08_person_id FROM tdm08_manager_info WHERE tdm08_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm08_manager_type = '21' AND tdm08_org_id = tdm51_org_id AND tdm50_start_date BETWEEN tdm08_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm08_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) tdm08 ON TRUE INNER JOIN ( SELECT tdm43_manl_org_id , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm43_task_relate_duty_id) duty_cnt , COUNT(*) manl_cnt FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(tdm43_start_date,'1900-01-01'::date) <= (CAST(#{checkYm} AS varchar)||'.01')::date GROUP BY tdm43_manl_org_id ) tdm43 ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm51_manl_org_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) month_manl_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '26' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_26_cnt /*승인반려(26)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_25_cnt /*승인완료(25)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_21_cnt /*승인진행(21)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_20_cnt /*승인요청(20)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '19' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_19_cnt /*점검완료(19)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_11_cnt /*점검진행(11)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_10_cnt /*점검대기(10)*/ FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id ) tdm52 ON TRUE WHERE tdm51_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm51_check_ym = #{checkYm} AND tdm51_role_id = #{roleId} ) t ORDER BY t.tdm51_org_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} AND COALESCE(sys10_admin_yn, 'false') = 'true'
mapper.select: SELECT tdm56_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name FROM tdm56_chck_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm56_appr_id WHERE tdm56_relate_table_id = #{relateTableId} AND tdm56_ceo_role_id = #{ceoRoleId} ORDER BY tdm56_appr_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tdm56_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name FROM tdm56_chck_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm56_appr_id WHERE tdm56_relate_table_id = #{relateTableId} AND tdm56_ceo_role_id = #{ceoRoleId}

SELECT tdm53_chck_exct_id AS chck_exct_id , tdm53_company_id AS company_id , tdm53_exct_id AS exct_id , TO_CHAR(tdm53_upd_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS upd_date , tdm53_check_ym AS check_ym , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm53_exct_id) AS exct_name , sys01_loc_nm AS loc_name FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm53_role_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = tdm53_company_id WHERE tdm53_chck_exct_id = #{chckExctId}
